name: The Brothers Karamazov
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Brothers Karamazov was written by Fyodor Dostoevsky, first published in 1880.
Three brothers and their father's murder become the lens for Dostoevsky's deepest questions about faith, free will, and morality -- his final novel.
Discussion prompt: Faith & Doubt is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
